visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins in an indoor studio setting where a young woman with short black hair and bangs is the central figure. She is wearing a beige knitted cardigan over a white dress with lace detailing. She stands in front of a white pegboard wall decorated with small plants and a gold YouTube Creator Award. She holds a black Samsung smartphone in her right hand and holds up three fingers on her left hand to the camera, smiling with an energetic facial expression. (2) The scene transitions to a screen recording of a smartphone interface. It shows a web browser with a large, illuminated white Christmas tree as the focal point of a photo. A "Gemini Live" interface overlay appears at the bottom of the screen with a text bubble. The screen then scrolls through a gallery of photos and interacts with the AI assistant, which displays location information about Shin Kong Mitsukoshi in Taipei. (3) The woman is now outdoors at night in front of the massive white Christmas tree seen earlier. The tree is densely decorated with warm white lights and large gold ornaments. The woman poses for a photo, and the camera shows the phone screen again. A blurry photo is visible, which is then processed by a "Remaster" feature using a slider, making the image sharp. Subsequently, an "Object Eraser" tool is used to circle a person in the background, who then disappears. (4) The perspective focuses tightly on the smartphone's camera interface. The camera aims at the "MERRY CHRISTMAS" sign on the tree. The user interacts with the zoom slider, showing a progression from 1x wide shot to a 5x, 10x, and finally a 40x extreme close-up. The text on the sign remains legible and sharp despite the high magnification. The background shows blurred city lights and structural elements of the shopping mall. (5) The woman takes a selfie in front of the decorated tree, holding the phone in a handheld position. She uses a stylus or her finger to draw a rough triangular shape above her head on the photo. The phone's AI "Sketch to Image" feature processes the drawing for a few seconds, resulting in a realistic, textured red and white Santa hat appearing perfectly placed on her head in the photo. She smiles broadly at the result. (6) The woman stands in a different part of the outdoor shopping area, near a glass window display with large silver decorative baubles. She demonstrates the "Gemini Live" feature again, which shows dining recommendations and map details on the screen. Finally, she returns to the Christmas tree, tells the camera person to keep filming, then turns around and runs away into the crowd. The camera follows her movement in a shaky, handheld pursuit shot.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Subtitle]: 教你3招. [Logo]: @HanHan. (2) [Subtitle]: 用 Samsung Galaxy S25 Ultra 拍出聖誕節美照. (3) [Subtitle]: 首先呢 先找一個符合聖誕節氛圍的地點. (4) [Subtitle]: 像我就在社群找了這一棵超美的聖誕樹. (5) [Subtitle]: 直接用 Gemini Live 分享螢幕畫面找到地點. (6) [Subtitle]: 請問一下這棵聖誕樹是在哪裡. (7) [Subtitle]: 這棵聖誕樹在新光三越信義新天地 A11 館的北天門前喔. (8) [Subtitle]: 每天的 4:00 到 10:30 都會有絢爛的燈光音樂秀. (9) [Subtitle]: 你也想去現場看看嗎. (10) [Subtitle]: 哇它真的超快就找出來的 那我們就走吧. (11) [Subtitle]: 哇這拍照技術也太差了吧. (12) [Subtitle]: 來用 S25 Ultra 的內建修圖把照片變清晰. (13) [Subtitle]: 還能順便把路人消除掉 完美的聖誕節照片就完成啦. (14) [Subtitle]: 想拍遠處的燈海或花圈 從1倍、5倍、10倍到40倍都能拍. (15) [Subtitle]: 即使一路放大細節還是能清楚保留. (16) [Subtitle]: 拉近拍真的超有氣氛. (17) [Subtitle]: 跟聖誕樹自拍之後覺得太單調了. (18) [Subtitle]: 點一下 AI 快速幫我生成小花、光點或是聖誕帽. (19) [Subtitle]: 是不是更有過節的感覺啦. (20) [Subtitle]: 用 S25 Ultra 搭配 Gemini Live. (21) [Subtitle]: 一台手機就能拍照、查景點還可以順便找附近的餐廳. (22) [Subtitle]: 聖誕節出門拍照變得更簡單了. (23) [Subtitle]: 那你就繼續幫我拍照吧. (24) [Variety]: （逃跑）. (25) [Subtitle]: 啊你怎麼跑走了.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio starts with a high-energy female vocal narration. The voice has a bright pitch and fast speech rate with clear articulation. The background music is an upbeat electronic pop track with a strong, rhythmic drum beat and a tempo of approximately 124 BPM. The ambient environment is silent, suggesting a studio recording for the voiceover. (2) A digital "ding" notification sound triggers a phase shift. A calm, professional male AI voice enters the mix, providing information with a flat, neutral intonation. The female voice responds with a high-pitched, surprised "Wow!" followed by the sound of a camera shutter clicking twice in rapid succession. The electronic BGM continues at a consistent volume. (3) As the setting moves outdoors, a subtle low-frequency urban hum becomes the ambient noise floor. The female voice remains the dominant signal, narrating the photo editing process with a cheerful and engaging tone. Multiple UI "whoosh" sound effects are synchronized with the visual transitions on the phone screen. The BGM remains steady. (4) During the zoom demonstration, a series of short, digital sliding SFX are heard, corresponding to the movement of the zoom bar. The female voice's intensity increases slightly to emphasize the technical achievement of the 40x zoom. The BGM rhythm is very prominent here, with synthesized bass hits. (5) A magical "sparkle" or "chime" sound effect is used to highlight the AI generation of the Santa hat. The female voice expresses excitement with a rising intonation pattern. The music remains upbeat, maintaining the energetic pace of the video. No significant ambient noise interferes with the clear narration. (6) In the final phase, the female voice becomes more casual as she talks to the camera operator. As she begins to run, the vocal volume decreases as she moves away from the microphone, and the sound of rapid, percussive footsteps on a hard pavement surface is clearly audible. A final "Ah!" shout is heard from a distance before the BGM fades out.
